import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as func


class BlockNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.head = nn.Conv2d(3, 12, 3, padding=1)
        self.gate = nn.BatchNorm2d(12)
        self.tail = nn.Conv2d(12, 48, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(48, 24, 3, padding=1)
        self.neck = nn.BatchNorm2d(24)
        self.merge = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.encode = nn.Flatten()
        self.stem = nn.Linear(24, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        alpha = self.head(x)
        delta = self.gate(alpha)
        omega = func.tanh(delta)
        sigma = self.tail(omega)
        theta = func.tanh(sigma)
        kappa = self.proj(theta)
        lam = self.neck(kappa)
        rho = func.tanh(lam)
        tau = self.merge(rho)
        beta = self.encode(tau)
        gamma = self.stem(beta)
        return gamma

import torch.nn.functional as fn


class FeatureNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(FeatureNet, self).__init__()
        self.post = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.shrink = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(16, 16) for _ in range(4)]
        )
        self.merge = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        alpha = self.post(x)
        beta = fn.silu(alpha)
        for omega in self.shrink:
            beta = omega(beta)
        gamma = fn.silu(beta)
        delta = self.merge(gamma)
        return delta

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as fn


class FeatureNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(FeatureNet, self).__init__()
        self.post = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.shrink = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(16, 16) for _ in range(4)]
        )
        self.merge = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.post(x)
        h2 = fn.silu(h1)
        for layer in self.shrink:
            h2 = layer(h2)
        h3 = fn.silu(h2)
        h4 = self.merge(x)
        return h4

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class BlockNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(BlockNet, self).__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(32, 32, bias=False)
        self.stack1 = nn.Sequential()
        for _ in range(4):
            self.stack1.append(nn.Linear(32, 32, bias=False))
            self.stack1.append(nn.Sigmoid())
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(32, 2, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        alpha = self.fc1(x)
        beta = F.sigmoid(alpha)
        gamma = self.stack1(beta)
        delta = self.fc2(gamma)
        return delta

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Classifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(Classifier, self).__init__()
        self.expand = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.wide = False
        self.post = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.encode = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.merge = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.neck = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.shrink = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.pre = nn.Linear(16, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.expand(x)
        x = torch.sigmoid(x)
        if self.wide:
            x = self.post(x)
        omega = self.encode(x)
        delta = self.proj(x)
        x = torch.cat([omega, delta], dim=1)
        gamma = self.merge(x)
        beta = self.neck(x)
        alpha = self.shrink(x)
        x = gamma + beta
        x = x + alpha
        x = self.pre(x)
        return x

class Classifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(Classifier, self).__init__()
        self.expand = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.wide = False
        self.post = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.encode = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.merge = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.neck = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.shrink = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.pre = nn.Linear(16, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.expand(x)
        x_ref = x
        x = torch.sigmoid(x_ref)
        if self.wide:
            x = self.post(x)
        u = self.encode(x)
        right = self.proj(x)
        x = torch.cat([u, right], dim=1)
        q = self.merge(x)
        p = self.neck(x)
        c = self.shrink(x)
        x = q + p
        x = x + c
        x = self.pre(x)
        return x

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        """Model built for the graph task."""
        super().__init__()
        self.fc_1 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.act_1 = nn.GELU()
        self.extra_head = False
        self.fc_2 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.fc_3 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.fc_4 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.fc_5 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.fc_6 = nn.Linear(32, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        beta = self.fc_1(x)
        beta = self.act_1(beta)
        if self.extra_head:
            beta = self.fc_2(beta)
        gamma = self.fc_3(beta)
        alpha = self.fc_4(beta)
        delta = self.fc_5(beta)
        beta = gamma + alpha
        beta = beta + delta

class MyNet(nn.Module):

        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc4 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc5 = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.fc6 = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.fc7 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc8 = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        beta = self.fc1(x)
        beta = func.tanh(beta)
        delta = self.fc2(beta)
        gamma = self.fc3(beta)
        omega = self.fc4(beta)
        beta = delta + gamma
        beta = beta + omega
        omega = self.fc5(beta)
        alpha = self.fc6(beta)
        beta = torch.cat([omega, alpha], dim=1)
        beta = self.fc7(beta)
        beta = func.tanh(beta)
        beta = self.fc7(beta)
        beta = self.fc8(beta)
        return beta

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as func


class MyNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc4 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc5 = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.fc6 = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.fc7 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc8 = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.fc1(x)
        h_ref = h
        h = func.tanh(h_ref)
        right = self.fc2(h)
        q = self.fc3(h)
        u = self.fc4(h)
        h = right + q
        h = h + u
        u = self.fc5(h)
        c = self.fc6(h)
        h = torch.cat([u, c], dim=1)
        h = self.fc7(h)
        h = func.tanh(h)
        h = self.fc7(h)
        h = self.fc8(h)
        return h

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as fn


class Encoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.f3 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.f4 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.f5 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.f6 = nn.Linear(16, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        beta = self.f1(x)
        beta = fn.gelu(beta)
        # the same layer applied twice
        beta = self.f2(beta)
        beta = fn.gelu(beta)
        beta = self.f2(beta)
        gamma = self.f3(beta)
        alpha = self.f4(beta)
        delta = self.f5(beta)
        beta = gamma + alpha
        beta = beta + delta
        beta = self.f6(beta)
        return beta

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as fn


class FeatureNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc_1 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc_2 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc_3 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc_4 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc_5 = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.fc_6 = nn.Linear(16, 4)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc_1(x)
        x = fn.tanh(x)
        gamma = self.fc_2(x)
        beta = self.fc_3(x)
        alpha = self.fc_4(x)
        x = gamma + beta
        x = x + alpha
        x = self.fc_5(x)
        x = fn.tanh(x)
        x = self.fc_5(x)
        x = self.fc_6(x)
        return x

from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class FeatureNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.f3 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.f4 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.f5 = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.f6 = nn.Linear(32, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        beta = self.f1(x)
        beta = F.silu(beta)
        # the same layer applied twice
        beta = self.f2(beta)
        beta = F.silu(beta)
        beta = self.f2(beta)
        gamma = self.f3(beta)
        alpha = self.f4(beta)
        delta = self.f5(beta)
        beta = gamma + alpha
        beta = beta + delta
        beta = self.f6(beta)
        return beta

        self.f3 = nn.Linear(24, 24, bias=False)

        self.f5 = nn.Linear(24, 24, bias=False)

        alpha = self.f1(x)
        beta = self.a1(alpha)
        rho = self.f2(beta)
        lam = self.f3(beta)
        tau = self.f4(beta)
        gamma = rho + lam
        delta = gamma + tau
        omega = self.f5(delta)
        sigma = self.a1(omega)
        theta = sigma + delta
        kappa = self.f6(theta)
        return kappa

        self.conv_1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.act_1 = nn.Sigmoid()
        self.conv_2 = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 1, padding=0)
        self.conv_3 = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv_4 = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 5, padding=2)
        self.act_2 = nn.Sigmoid()
        self.pool_1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flat_1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc_1 = nn.Linear(24, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        beta = self.conv_1(x)
        gamma = self.act_1(beta)
        alpha = self.conv_2(gamma)
        rho = self.conv_3(gamma)
        lam = self.conv_4(gamma)
        delta = torch.cat([alpha, rho, lam], dim=1)
        omega = self.act_2(delta)
        sigma = self.pool_1(omega)
        theta = self.flat_1(sigma)
        kappa = self.fc_1(theta)
        return kappa

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class Head(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.d1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.u1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.c4 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.p1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.f1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.f1_2 = nn.Linear(16, 2, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        # down path
        alpha = self.c1(x)
        alpha = torch.tanh(alpha)
        alpha = self.d1(alpha)
        alpha = self.c2(alpha)
        alpha = torch.tanh(alpha)
        # up path, with the skip concatenated back in
        alpha = self.u1(alpha)
        alpha = self.c3(alpha)
        alpha = torch.cat([alpha, alpha], dim=1)
        alpha = self.c4(alpha)
        alpha = torch.tanh(alpha)
        alpha = self.p1(alpha)
        alpha = self.f1(alpha)
        alpha = self.f1_2(alpha)
        return alpha

from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as func


class Classifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        """Classifier built for the graph task."""
        super(Classifier, self).__init__()
        self.conv_1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv_2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 1, padding=0)
        self.conv_3 = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv_4 = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 5, padding=2)
        self.pool_1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flat_1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc_1 = nn.Linear(48, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        gamma = self.conv_1(x)
        gamma = func.silu(gamma)
        beta = self.conv_2(gamma)
        delta = self.conv_3(gamma)
        alpha = self.conv_4(gamma)
        gamma = torch.cat([beta, delta, alpha], dim=1)
        gamma = func.silu(gamma)
        gamma = self.pool_1(gamma)
        gamma = self.flat_1(gamma)
        gamma = self.fc_1(gamma)
        return gamma

        x = self.f1(x)

        rho = self.c2(gamma)

        omega = self.a1(delta)
        sigma = self.p1(omega)
        theta = self.f1(sigma)
        kappa = self.f1_2(theta)
        return kappa

import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as func


class Head(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        """Head built for the graph task."""
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.down_1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.conv_2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 32, 3, padding=1)
        self.up_1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2)
        self.conv_3 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv_4 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.pool_1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flat_1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc_1 = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # down path
        alpha = self.conv_1(x)
        sigma = func.relu(alpha)
        theta = self.down_1(sigma)
        kappa = self.conv_2(theta)
        lam = func.relu(kappa)
        # up path, with the skip concatenated back in
        rho = self.up_1(lam)
        tau = self.conv_3(rho)

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class SmallNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(16)
        self.a1 = nn.MultiheadAttention(16, 1, batch_first=True)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(16)
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(16, 32)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(32, 16)

    def forward(self, x):
        beta = self.n1(x)
        lam, alpha = self.a1(beta, beta, beta)
        gamma = lam + x
        delta = self.n2(gamma)
        omega = self.f1(delta)
        sigma = F.gelu(omega)
        theta = self.f2(sigma)
        kappa = theta + gamma
        return kappa
